entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Queen Tamar, a notable figure in the history of Georgia, associated with Golden Age of Georgia (1184–1213). Preceded by Trebizond Empire and David the Builder liberates Tbilisi from the Arab emirate. Their legacy influenced Shota Rustaveli composes 'The Knight in the Panther's Skin' and Georgian armies help establish the Empire of Trebizond.
